blocks.html: Find who you can reach, how to reach them, and pull up a callsign's details without leaving the map.

slides.title: Open the Contacts list
slides.html: Open the Contacts tool to see everyone on the network. The last column shows each callsign's default communication type. Use Unread Only and Show All at the bottom to limit the list.

slides.title: Filter by communication type
slides.html: Tap the arrow next to Contacts at the top of the list. Pick a type — Data Package, GeoChat, Email, Phone, SMS, VoIP or XMPP — to show only callsigns reachable that way.

slides.title: Filter and favourite callsigns
slides.html: Use multi-select to tick callsigns and remove them from the list and map; enable Hide Filtered Contacts to keep them off. To favourite a contact, tap the Star icon, tap the + icon, choose the contact(s), then tap Add.

slides.title: Sort and search
slides.html: Tap the Sort icon to reorder the list — alphabetically, by connection status, by unread messages or by distance from you. Each tap changes the sort. Tap the Search icon and type to jump to a specific callsign.

slides.title: Open a contact profile card
slides.html: Tap the second-to-last column for any callsign to open its profile card. It shows role, software version, node type, default connector, last report time, battery, location and the comms types available for that contact.
